author: ojiudezue
title: v5.108.20 shipped: Perimeter alerts: daylight-only demotes, every gate decision logged
summary: Perimeter alerts: daylight-only demotes, every gate decision logged
why: Operator ruled single-source demotion should apply only in daylight, never after sunset, because at night a lone detection is more likely a real person and demoting it hides it. Gate decisions were not persisted, so nobody could score whether the gates helped or hurt alert hygiene; rows now make that measurable weekly. The VLM location check failed its replay (street recall 31%) so it ships dark rather than being dropped.
implications: Shipped PERIMETER-ZONE-AGREEMENT-FIX-OR-REMOVE-1, PERIMETER-GATE-DECISIONS-NOT-PERSISTED-1 at v5.108.20; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.108.20.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: Re-run the D0-B VLM location replay with the GPT-6 entry before flipping PERIMETER_VLM_LOCATION_ASK; revisit gate-row retention on MEMORY-EPISODES-PERIMETER-GATE-RETENTION-1 if memory_episodes growth exceeds 90 MB/yr.

refs.release_notes: Single-source and uncorroborated-door demotes now apply only in daylight (sun at or above 0 deg; unreadable sun = night). Every perimeter gate decision is written to memory_episodes (perimeter_gate_decision) with sun elevation, for weekly scoring. The VLM location question is built but ships dark (PERIMETER_VLM_LOCATION_ASK=False) after its replay failed. See docs/readmes/README_v5.108.20.md.
